name: Mitaki Manami
source: Michito's colleague. She is in charge of catalog production in Edendo's planning and sales department. She's pretty modest, having no outstanding achievements, but also never late or absent. In fact, she's always the first one to arrive and is cleaning the office by the time the other employees arrive. On her days off, she is quite lethargic, kind of like a dried-up fish. She doesn't find the daily routine of work very appealing.
